notes: Owner requests the whole center area supported by G52/G53/G54/G55, allowing adjacent cameras. One editable multi-group block avoids duplicated seats/tables across group ROI files. Existing first-floor blocks/layouts are retained.

32 seats: H56–H87 exactly once, comprising four three-seat curved teal sofas, twelve cream barrel chairs and eight dark leather chairs. Ten separate round pale-marble/brass tables: H22/H23/H24/H26/H27/H28/H29/H31/H32/H33.

Groups are camera evidence collections, not room boundaries: H22 observes H96/H97, H34 observes H50/H51, H29 observes H90/H94/H95, and H44 observes H43. These belong to neighboring bays and are explicitly excluded. Table_H36 is also excluded.
H37 fixes the continuous wood end wall, two curved sofas, flanking potted plants, shaded lamp and central abstract sculpture. H41 fixes the opposite sofa pair and open buffet approach.

H33/H43 reverse side views establish dark-tile circulation between central carpet and neighboring seating; H36/H35 distinguish neighboring sofa/armchair bays from the central room. H40 supports the opposing cream cluster, central tree and far-end arrangement. H23 supports the wood end and side-window return context; its chairs are outside this block.

Two trees occupy flush gravel/underplanting beds along the carpet centerline. Paired dark chairs sit against low ribbed brass/glass side dividers. Brass arch frames and pleated hanging shades follow the visible long-side lighting system; their exact spans/count/height remain provisional.

The side windows and tall structural columns belong beyond the excluded adjacent seating, so no full-height side walls or window enclosure are invented along the center crop. Buffet counters are beyond the open end and not reconstructed under these group IDs.

Specific curved sofas, cream barrel chairs, brown leather barrel chairs, tree beds and pendant/frame variants are opt-in procedural approximations. Other saved furniture keeps existing builders. Carpet uses a matte woven procedural material with tree-bed cutouts.
All lengths, furniture yaw, exact seat-slot orientation, tree/fixture geometry and map alignment remain unmeasured estimates. H44 remains unplaced in registration; it is used only for visual overlap.
